lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg2Li2Fe8O16 (MgLi(FeO2)4) is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with 28 atoms in the unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Mg and Li each have eight O neighbors and O adopts four-vertex coordination. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Fe octahedra and edge-sharing between Fe octahedra and Mg 8-vertex polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
